propositions: Canonical contributor guidance documents hardcode a specific bot identity (Joe Oakhart) despite project policy requiring contributors to sign with their own configured git identity

AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and .agents/rules/rebar.md provide contradictory DCO sign-off instructions, with some prescribing a hardcoded third-party identity rather than the committer's own configured name and email
No deterministic lint check exists to prevent reintroduction of hardcoded personal sign-off identities in contributor-facing documentation

Guidance must be updated to instruct actors to use git config user.name and user.email for DCO sign-off, with Joe Oakhart's bot identity retained only in automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/fixtures/)

A make lint-integrated grep step must be implemented to enforce consistency and fail the build if hardcoded joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com or 'Signed-off-by: Joe Oakhart' strings appear in contributor-facing docs (excluding docs/experiments/)
